overall_assessment: Amritha possesses a strong foundation in software development, particularly in full-stack technologies and emerging AI areas. The resume highlights project-based learning and adaptability. To enhance co-op and internship prospects, the primary focus should be on acquiring practical skills in DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (deepening AWS knowledge and exploring others like GCP/Azure), as these are frequently mentioned in job descriptions. Demonstrating a more robust understanding and application of C++ would also be beneficial for roles specifically requesting it. The identified gaps are generally addressable through focused, short-to-medium term learning initiatives, positioning Amritha well for entry-level software roles.
top_recommendations: Solidify Docker knowledge: Complete the Docker 101 tutorial (URL: https://www.docker.com/101-tutorial) and ensure Docker is prominently featured in your skills and project descriptions.
Learn Kubernetes basics: Work through the Kubernetes tutorial series (URL: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/) to understand core concepts like Pods, Services, and Deployments.

Expand Cloud Platform skills: Complete Google Cloud's 'Cloud Essentials' learning path (URL: https://cloud.google.com/learn/training/cloud-essentials) to gain familiarity with GCP, complementing your existing AWS knowledge.

Integrate CI/CD into a project: Learn about Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment by setting up a basic GitHub Actions workflow for one of your personal projects (URL: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/quickstart).

Detail C++ Project Experience: If you have academic or personal projects using C++, explicitly detail them on your resume. Highlight specific challenges, algorithms, or performance optimizations achieved to align with roles requiring C++.
